CustomField.description: Addresses that receive the dry runs of EmailService (alert DryRun__c, EmailRequest.dryRun, Flow input Dry Run, ForceDryRun__c), one per line. Set on the org default (e.g. salesforcesupport@carmignac.com) and copied to the sandboxes on refresh; a profile or user value overrides it (e.g. a developer receiving his own dry runs). Empty: a dry run fails with a configuration error.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Addresses that receive the dry-run emails, one per line (e.g. salesforcesupport@carmignac.com). A user or profile value replaces the org default for that user's emails.
CustomField.label: Dry Run Addresses
